decisive_spans.text: Noncontrast CT of the head revealed a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern isodense to gray matter without calcifications

response.rationale: Epidermoid cysts are typically isodense to gray matter on non-contrast CT and do not restrict diffusion, which is strongly supported by the vignette. Schwannomas are a common differential in this location but lack the specific imaging characteristics of an epidermoid cyst.
